review.shorterRoute: Reuse the existing original primitive residual realization rather than constructing another local coefficient field or stable lattice. Its original spanning specialization lets the proved determinant, Frobenius quadratic and inertia theorems apply to that same representation. Native linear-equivalence conjugacy, injectivity of polynomial coefficient extension and Matrix.charpoly_map transport the polynomial through the existing basis and residue map. The original Fourier coefficient integrality supplies its exact integral lift. For the next all-weight source branch, inspected SourcePrimitiveGaloisAlternative and SourceOriginalFinitePadicSpecialization: compatibility with a prescribed reduction remains required; the existing originalPadicHeckeEigencharacter already accepts a prescribed coefficient embedding, so that narrower route is available without rebuilding the Tate geometry.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: The existing integral and residual representations are trivial on source inertia away from the level and Tate prime. The original field Frobenius polynomial descends to the actual integral basis and reduces to the exact original Fourier residue polynomial. The residual trace and determinant follow in the actual finite characteristic-ell residue field. The assembled consumer supplies every specialization, lattice-basis and residue-map premise from the existing genuine construction.
